`final class Lwjgl3AlBinding`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IAlBinding`](/reference/base-openal/ialbinding/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.glfw.binding` · **Module:** `base-glfw` · **Source:** [Lwjgl3AlBinding.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/glfw/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/glfw/binding/Lwjgl3AlBinding.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span> <span class="joid-badge">Vulkan</span>

The OpenAL binding of LWJGL 3, given to `AlAudioBridge` by the LWJGL 3 and Vulkan backends.

## Description

It lives in base-glfw because base-openal depends on no LWJGL version.

## Learn more

- [OpenAL of LWJGL 3](/build/base-modules/glfw/#openal-of-lwjgl-3)
- [base-openal](/build/base-modules/openal/)
- [LWJGL 3 backend](/build/backends/lwjgl3/)
- [Vulkan backend](/build/backends/vulkan/)

<a id="Lwjgl3AlBinding-method-createContext"></a>

### createContext

`void createContext()` 

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: OpenAL cannot open the default audio device, check that an audio output device is connected and enabled
- `IllegalStateException`: OpenAL cannot create a context on the default audio device, check that no other application holds it exclusively and that its driver is up to date

Opens the default device with `alcOpenDevice`, creates a context on it and makes it current.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when no output device opens, or when the device refuses a context.
